items.reason: The approved MCP SDK v2 capability is not implemented: the direct dependency and frozen lock remain on MCP v1, the server still uses FastMCP, and the required v2 client modes and evidence tests are absent. Repository source directly establishes the gap, so this is product implementation drift rather than framework-tooling drift.

items.statement: A frozen UV installation resolves the reviewed MCP 2.x release and excludes MCP 1.x and unsupported future majors.
The aio-agentic-sdlc-mcp stdio entry point exposes every existing tool, resource, and prompt with compatible names and schemas through MCPServer.
The official v2 in-memory Client can list and exercise the complete public MCP surface in modern auto mode and legacy mode.
Concurrent worker-thread execution of synchronous stateful handlers preserves workspace, backlog, audit, mapping, path, lock, and working-directory invariants.
Invalid inputs, outputs, URIs, paths, and handler failures are rejected with deterministic protocol-visible error semantics and no protected-state mutation.
The full warning-strict suite, static checks, build, plugin validators, traceability validation, and canonical Reality/reconciliation reproduction pass on the migrated dependency graph.
